summary: 12 TCs reviewed; 1 real LOW-severity defect: factory's sync() REPLACES integration.config rather than merging. Connect-time probe data is overwritten on first sync. Inconsistent with personal-provider behaviour. All 10 declarative providers verified — slugs, probe_urls, auth_header functions, scopes, per_user flags correct. Slack's Exception-on-error idiom (line 233-235) using `(_ for _ in ()).throw(...)` is unusual but functionally correct.

defects.description: Factory sync replaces integration.config entirely (line 114-116 in _factory.py) instead of merging. Connect-time probe data and any extra fields are lost on first sync.
defects.actual: `integration.config = (spec.parse_sync(body) if spec.parse_sync else {'ok': True})` — full replacement

defects.description: Slack parse_probe uses generator-throw idiom for raising — unusual but functional.
defects.actual: `(_ for _ in ()).throw(Exception(...))` — works because lambda can't `raise`

notes: DEF-112-01 will be batched into the audit-fixup commit at end of campaign.
DEF-112-02 is style — Python lambdas can't have statements, so generator-throw is a known workaround. Not a defect.
